candidate_identity.exact_finite_identity: F_Omega(N) = ordered set of tuples (path, token, arity, token_length)
candidate_identity.human_summary: H_N(z) remains a coarse depth profile, while S_N records exact branch/path structure.

mathematical_observation: For finite ordered hierarchical numbers, the exact path signature is injective: if two signatures are equal, every occupied path and token is equal, so the trees are identical.
important_limit: This establishes uniqueness only inside the formal finite-tree model. It does not prove the physical axiom that all realized numbers in nature are unique.
